scope: bounded risk classification and later qualified native Guard controls; not future representation prediction or certified veto-utility learning

admission.limitation: VETO pairs show mixed utility. Wrong-accept classification labels are not beneficial-action labels. No SPLIT/RELINK enabled.

training_state: sealed original GMT histories and complete native candidates, same-context C1 primary choices; off-policy relative to later C1/Guard mutated histories
training_precision: 11 FP16 stored native feature assets dequantized toFP32 plus originalFP32 TRAIN12; inference must still use true FP32 actual native evidence
labels: risk_label0/1 only; UNKNOWN null masked, never a negative; person/scene keys used only offline to weight dependence groups and audit coverage

architectures.grouped_risk: two6-scalar evidence tokens, shared Linear6to8 + learned2x8 type biases/ReLU, learned8-dimensional query softmax pooling, Linear8to88/ReLU/Linear88to1
architectures.interpretation: small local/global evidence aggregation hypothesis; no structural superiority assumed

shared_training.later_seeds: after first-seed complete native online comparison; do not drop preregistered controls merely for a negative first seed
shared_training.normalization: same known-FIT-feature mean/std for both models, std floor0.001; save as deployment buffers
shared_training.loss: BCEWithLogits, class-balanced and inverse observation-count weighted within each(scene,person,label) group; mean record weight1
shared_training.sample_order: full known-record permutation each epoch from a separate seed+1001 Torch Generator, identical across models; every eligible FIT record visited twice
shared_training.threshold: on known FIT records only, maximize risk-classification F1 under correct-record false-positive-rate<=0.001; tie chooses higher threshold; deploy strict logit>threshold; no DEV threshold search

deployment: both heads receive identical GT-free native-risk12 evidence and identical legal VETO/native constrained Hungarian/second-validation limits; original initialization and Bank unchanged; GT does not enter model, controller or solver
qualification: CPU shape/parameter-count/leakage/RNG/serialization contracts, actual native feature parity and default OFF/KEEP, fault rollback, then complete matched DEV videos; model construction/loading must not consume deployment RNG
primary_DEV_selection: stock50 HOTA on predeclared strict5 legal-GT scope, disclose all12 inference, raw metrics, CVIDF1/IDSW/Frag/FPS and harm groups; threshold and epoch remain frozen; no TEST selection
scientific_claim_rule: risk-classification fit is not online improvement; grouped model must beat ordinary MLP in actual matched native evaluation before any unique structured-risk claim
final_TRAIN24: after architecture/protocol choice, new full24 native evidence admission and masked supervision coverage required; train both eligible heads from scratch with seed17/two full epochs, no claim that current FIT12 is full24; seeds19/23 are robustness checks, not best-seed selection
official_TEST: not started or authorized by this protocol alone; separate final frozen full24 gate remains mandatory
